cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 105 since November 2018. Served in the Alabama National Guard on active duty 2001–2009, including as a military adviser in Kabul. Worked as an engineering project manager and corporate PR director, and has been a real estate advisor since 2021.
cands.gaps: We found no documented actions or stated positions from Chip Brown on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on out-of-state or foreign land buyers, growth limits, immigration or H-1B, policing, guns, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. His campaign site lists broad themes such as protecting waterways, support for farms and a focus on education, but gives no specifics. Ballotpedia's list of bills he sponsored did not load, so we could not report any. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate surveys in 2022 or 2026. No endorsements were found for 2026. We could not find his exact birthplace or hometown. His campaign site appears to date from his 2018 run, so its job description may be out of date.

qual.background: Alabama House member since 2018 (re-elected 2022); earlier a project manager at Proctor Environmental Engineering, director of corporate public relations at Volkert, Inc., CEO of a security training firm, and National Guard officer and military adviser; real estate advisor since 2021.
qual.why: Seven years of legislative service plus management and business experience put him in the high band; committee roles, including the chair of the Ports, Waterways and Intermodal Transit Committee, were not counted. His career is not in law or budget work.
